crossRefs.note: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”
Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,

translations.web: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”
translations.bsb: This is why “it was credited to him as righteousness.”
translations.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
translations.asv: Wherefore also it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
